title: MSFS 2024 Marketplace: Massive Scenery Drop (Delhi, Antarctica & Bush Strips)
description:
The MSFS 2024 Marketplace just dropped a massive global scenery update—from major international hubs like New Delhi (VIDP) and Sacramento (KSMF) to icy Antarctica runways and rugged bush strips.

In this week's Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 Marketplace showcase, we tour the latest airport and scenery releases across every corner of the globe. Whether you fly long-haul airliners into Indira Gandhi International (VIDP), Pittsburgh (KPIT), Cali (SKCL), and Fès–Saïs (GMFF), or prefer backcountry bush flying with Orbx's Papua New Guinea and California Lost Landings packs, there is something here for your flight plan. We also check out polar operations at Antarctica's British Rothera Research Station (EGAR), UK and US general aviation airfields from UK2000 Scenery and Burning Blue Design (EGPC, EGBM, KCMR), three remote Amazon Basin regional strips from Heaven Designs & BLG (SBUA, SWHT, SWTP), and MSFS 2024 exclusive city night lighting enhancements including Tel Aviv.
